study: Exploratory raw-unit small-strain PVC hold-state precision sensitivity
excluded_columns: 12:21 are source full-curve fitted values and must not be used as observations, validation targets or baseline fits
primary_selection: All five measured temperature curves in the first time-domain experimental sheet; none chosen by response values. No temperature pooling or shared kernel across temperatures
time_rule: Use each measured curve first and last recorded times to define its span. Pick nearest source time; stop on duplicates or targets not later than observations. No response interpolation
band_interpretation: Assumed absolute MPa observation bands equal to fraction times the first measured modulus, held fixed within a curve. Not estimated from fitting or later targets and not independently calibrated
numerical_scaling: Divide all raw MPa centers and bands by the same known recorded first modulus only for numerical conditioning. Anchor retains its error band. Do not treat the true initial modulus as exactly one
baseline: NNLS with equilibrium atom plus 128 geometric rates [1e-6,128]; nonnegative ridge lambda 0.001; positive 1/2-component Prony selected by early AIC with deterministic multistart. Same five early observations per window
material_state_model: Conditional nonnegative exponential hold-state continuation only, not loading-history reconstruction or a cross-temperature material model
stop_rule: Run this complete 5-temperature by 2-window by 3-band by 3-target design once; retain every failure. No band/window/temperature tuning to obtain a successful cell
claim_ceiling: Exploratory conditional feasibility and assumption sensitivity on published real measurements. Even successful cells do not establish calibrated material guarantee or superiority over the identical classical continuous LP
qualification_gaps: No synchronized complete strain/ramp/prehistory sequence in the inspected experimental sheet
No independent observation-specific modulus or input-error upper bounds in the relaxation columns
No replicate specimens at the same temperature in the inspected relaxation sheet; five temperatures are five conditions, not five independent replicates
Physical aging and time-invariant linear positive-spectrum validity require separate qualification
Three correlated targets on each curve cannot establish a population coverage probability
